remarks: Set in coveted North Hermosa, just one block from the beach, 2215 Manhattan Avenue is a striking contemporary residence offering exceptional scale, privacy, and sweeping ocean views in one of the South Bay’s most desirable locations. Built in 2017 and situated on an unusually wide 50-foot lot, the home takes full advantage of its setting. The additional width creates a wonderful sense of openness and privacy along the north side of the property while allowing the garage to be positioned discreetly along the side, preserving the home’s beautiful street presence.
